# Method selection by predicted demand growth (generated by code/growth_rule.py)

Growing = test demand > 1.5 × demand of the previous 26 weeks. The classifier, the two methods (A for predicted growth, B otherwise) and the share of series sent to A are all learned on the training window(s).
